rationale: Build on the best reverse-tail recurrent family with a compact anchor-source change instead of another scalar sweep. The recurrent pass now blends each repeated tail block toward its own first-pass decoder activation, while keeping the proven final decoder-output anchor as the default bias. This targets the still-promising anchor-refresh category without changing shapes, validation flow, wallclock behavior, or export path.
title: Reverse-Tail Local Anchor Mix
